test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

PROFUSE
solution: The correct answer is '**Scant**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**Profuse**' is '**Scant**'. • **Profuse**: given or produced in great quantity. (अत्‍यधिक मात्रा में, प्रचुर) • *Example: **profuse** apologies...* • **Scant**: not very much; not as much as necessary. [अत्‍यल्‍प (बहुत अधिक नहीं); अपर्याप्त (जितना अपेक्षित हो उतना नहीं)] • *Example: Food was in **scant** supply.* **Correct Answer:__** *Scant.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Sufficient**: as much as is necessary; enough. (जितना आवश्‍यक हो उतना; पर्याप्त) • **Lush**: (used about plants or gardens) growing very thickly and well. [(पौधे या बग़ीचे) घने और हरे-भरे] • **Plenty**: as much or as many of something as you need. (प्रचुर, बहुतायत, भरपूर) 3b:T5ce, The correct answer is** 'Suffer the worst of something'.**
